label: POST HOC, descriptive: what the validated v0.2 records carry per field (no hypothesis); the record reading is P11's (eval.p11.arms.record_status)

definitions.unsplit: value_role_unsplit: decision / dispatch date, where the record carries an answer date without saying which of the two it is
definitions.typed_gap: a typed null (null:<reason>) or an empty list with its typed reason (empty:<reason>)
definitions.untyped: absent (no value and no reason) or partial (a language of text for some documents only)
definitions.reading: P11's (eval.p11.arms.record_status), extended in R20 where it cannot see a typed reason (status): a role carried only as a typed null reads null:<reason>; a language of text missing only where the document's empty list carries a typed reason reads partial_typed:<reason> / empty:<reason> (typed_gap)
definitions.before: the same records without gegenprobe.schema.v0_2_meta (OPD metadata overlay)
definitions.extra: fields outside the 17 of the skeleton: answering_body, answer_identifier, type_harmonised, instrument_named

provenance.label: POST HOC, descriptive (R20): what each value's provenance is, over every provenance-bearing value
provenance.definitions: page_span: document, page and character span (quote or quote_sha256); page_only: an annotator's label located to a document page; document_level: a model's closed-set pick over a document; opd_record: basis metadata with an OPD record as source; other_record: basis metadata with another committed record as source; typed_null: a TypedNull with its reason; typed_empty_lists: empty_reasons entries
